thread:
alex: Quick rollout heads-up — planning to enable model `redwood-13b-v2` in the catalog for text-generation (eu-west-1). Staged plan: 5% canary -> 25% after 30m -> 100% after 3h. Change window tonight 22:00-01:00 UTC. Need infra + oncall ack and pinlist confirmation for Dedicated customers. Also need to finalize fallback eviction order.

alex: Fallback mapping proposal (prefix match order):
```
priority_map:
  - redwood-13b-v2
  - redwood-13b-v1
  - redwood-7b-q4
  - titan-lite
```
Will set eviction TTL on KV cache for 10m during canary.

taylor: Ack. Can we add an eviction override if KV cache key shapes are incompatible? I've seen hangs when seq-len differs. Suggest `kv_eviction: force` if cache miss rate > 15%.

samantha: Oncall here — okay with the window but I want explicit abort criteria. Propose abort if 5xx rate > 2x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency > 300ms above baseline for 5m. Also prefer ramp to 25% only after no SLI regressions for 15m.

aj: +1 from infra. Need to pin `redwood-13b-v1` for Dedicated customers during rollout. Which customers to exclude? If none, we'll auto-pin to previous default.

jamie: Product: I'll draft release notes + advisory to top 20 customers. Short blurb: "improved coherence and lower hallucination on long contexts; small regression risk on latency for very short prompts." Will share copy in #customer-comm in 30m.

alex: Good — exclusion list: none-specified, so default pin behavior will apply. Rollback command we will use if abort triggers: ``
rb-catalog --model redwood-13b-v2 --rollback-to redwood-13b-v1 --reason "canary-abort"
`` Try to keep canary at 5% for at least 20m before next step.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by alex: catalog.enable(model=redwood-13b-v2, region=eu-west-1, canary=5%) — job_id=job_20250321_84. ETA: scheduled for 2025-03-21 22:00:00 UTC.

aj: One ops note — gateway cooldown window is 90s, autoscaler warmup ~4m. We'll ensure the 25% step waits additional 5m to let nodes stabilize.

devops-bot: Preflight checks passed: model artifacts verified, quantization profile ok, kernel set selection matched hw. No infra flags.

alex: Final plan: start 22:00 UTC -> monitor SLIs with abort thresholds Samantha listed -> wait 20m at 5% -> move to 25% if green (allow +5m buffer) -> 100% at +3h if still green. If anyone objects, speak now. Otherwise I'll trigger at 22:00. :eyes:

samantha: Ok from oncall. I'll post a status check at +10m and +20m into the canary.

jamie: I'll send customer note after first 25% step.

taylor: I'll add the eviction override to the deploy job hook and document the fallback map in the rollout playbook.

alex: Thanks — triggering when window opens.
